evidence: The body rejects selector indices greater than 0x17 with result 2; otherwise it calls convert_attribute_value_to_float_div_100 for both object inputs, subtracts the converted values, and returns 0 when the difference exceeds +0.1, 2 when the difference is in [-0.1,+0.1], and 1 when the difference is below -0.1: decompiled/main/main_0116.c:16224-16264. Callers supply selectors 0x0c and 0x11 and consume/store the result: decompiled/main/main_0113.c:23371-23377, 48754-48759.

Rejects missing provider inputs with -2; reads player-attribute float properties 0x1e, 0x40, and 0x16, combines rounded integer values, derives a float score, and maps threshold ranges to return codes 1 through 5 (or -2 on the invalid low-sum path): decompiled/main/main_0119.c:21377-21458. Its caller stores the returned classification alongside neighboring attribute-property results: decompiled/main/main_0116.c:33990-33996.

The routine initializes/configures an attribute-context-like object, calls address-only helpers, reads selector 1 and selector 0x13/0x14 values, then stores two returned values at input offsets 0x98 and 0xa0: decompiled/main/main_0066.c:39433-39477. No indexed caller is available, and the address-only helper roles and meaning of those object fields are unresolved, so a semantic rename is not supported.

Uses the caller-supplied selector from x2 and property 0x11 via player_attribute_get_float, converts and combines the resulting values into a score, and returns a threshold band from 0 through 10; null/missing provider input returns -2: decompiled/main/main_0119.c:25185-25268. Callers pass selector 0x28 in one context and store the classification result in an output record: decompiled/main/main_0116.c:34291-34297; decompiled/main/main_0117.c:11535-11543.

For x0 values 0 through 3, loads a 32-bit value from the table at 0x7001d6cab0 indexed by x0; larger values use base value 1. It queries selector 0x13 and returns either that base value or three times it depending on the returned status checks: decompiled/main/main_0056.c:48857-48894. Its caller stores results for sequential inputs into byte fields beginning at object offset 0xf2: decompiled/main/main_0088.c:28692-28703.
